metadata.question: Does the plume from Whakaari/White Island, New Zealand travel in a southern direction on January 7, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Whakaari/White Island, NZ (lon, lat ≈ 177.18, -37.52). Analyze within 200 km radius.
- Primary dataset: Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 SO2 (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2) for 2025-01-07 (fallback to 2025-01-06..09 if empty).
- Fallback dataset: Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 Absorbing Aerosol Index (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI) with same date logic.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Not analyzing clouds directly; mask using qa_value >= 0.5, and cloud_fraction <= 0.5 if available.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- C1: No images in both primary and fallback after widened dates.
- C2: Images exist but after QA/cloud masking, count == 0 or excess-weight sum == 0.
- C3: Null/NaN in background or centroid/bearing computations.
- A/B: Compute background-subtracted “excess” and its weighted centroid; compute bearing from volcano to centroid. If bearing in [135°, 225°], infer southward plume (A), else (B).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const volcanoPt = ee.Geometry.Point([177.18, -37.52]); // White Island
    const region200 = volcanoPt.buffer({distance: 200000}); // 200 km
    const inner30 = volcanoPt.buffer({distance: 30000}); // 30 km
    const ringBG = region200.difference(inner30, 1);
    const startMain = '2025-01-07';
    const endMain = '2025-01-08';
    const startWide = '2025-01-06';
    const endWide = '2025-01-09';
    const scale = 5000;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    async function countImages(datasetId, start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId).filterDate(start, end);
      return await col.size().getInfo();
    }

    const dsSO2 = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2';
    const dsAI = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI';

    const so2MainCount = await countImages(dsSO2, startMain, endMain);
    console.log(`SO2 ${startMain}..${endMain}: ${so2MainCount} images`);
    let chosenDS = null, chosenStart = null, chosenEnd = null, chosenCount = 0, product = null;

    if (so2MainCount > 0) {
      chosenDS = dsSO2; chosenStart = startMain; chosenEnd = endMain; chosenCount = so2MainCount; product = 'SO2';
    } else {
      const so2WideCount = await countImages(dsSO2, startWide, endWide);
      console.log(`SO2 ${startWide}..${endWide}: ${so2WideCount} images`);
      if (so2WideCount > 0) {
        chosenDS = dsSO2; chosenStart = startWide; chosenEnd = endWide; chosenCount = so2WideCount; product = 'SO2';
      } else {
        const aiMainCount = await countImages(dsAI, startMain, endMain);
        console.log(`AER_AI ${startMain}..${endMain}: ${aiMainCount} images`);
        if (aiMainCount > 0) {
          chosenDS = dsAI; chosenStart = startMain; chosenEnd = endMain; chosenCount = aiMainCount; product = 'AER_AI';
        } else {
          const aiWideCount = await countImages(dsAI, startWide, endWide);
          console.log(`AER_AI ${startWide}..${endWide}: ${aiWideCount} images`);
          if (aiWideCount > 0) {
            chosenDS = dsAI; chosenStart = startWide; chosenEnd = endWide; chosenCount = aiWideCount; product = 'AER_AI';
          } else {
            console.log("No images in date/location across products.");
            console.log("C1");
            return;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Build collection
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(chosenDS).filterDate(chosenStart, chosenEnd);

    // Find available bands on first image
    const firstImg = col.first();
    const bandNames = await firstImg.bandNames().getInfo();
    const hasQA = bandNames.includes('qa_value');
    const hasCF = bandNames.includes('cloud_fraction');

    // Select signal band
    let signalBand = null;
    if (product === 'SO2') {
      const candidates = ['SO2_column_number_density', 'SO2_column_number_density_15km', 'SO2_column_number_density_7km'];
      signalBand = candidates.find(b => bandNames.includes(b));
      if (!signalBand) {
        console.log("SO2 signal band not found.");
        console.log("D");
        return;
      }
    } else {
      signalBand = 'absorbing_aerosol_index';
      if (!bandNames.includes(signalBand)) {
        console.log("AER_AI signal band not found.");
        console.log("D");
        return;
      }
    }

    // Map masking
    const qaThreshold = 0.5;
    const cfThreshold = 0.5;
    col = col.map(function(img) {
      let sig = img.select([signalBand]).rename(['signal']);
      let maskImg = ee.Image(1);
      if (hasQA) {
        maskImg = maskImg.and(img.select('qa_value').gte(qaThreshold));
      }
      if (hasCF) {
        maskImg = maskImg.and(img.select('cloud_fraction').lte(cfThreshold));
      }
      sig = sig.updateMask(maskImg);
      return sig.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
    });

    const composite = col.mean().select(['signal']);
    const validCount = await composite.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region200,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('signal').getInfo();

    console.log(`Chosen: ${product} ${chosenStart}..${chosenEnd} | Images: ${chosenCount}`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels (QA/cloud masked) in 200km: ${validCount}`);

    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }

    // Cloud fraction mean (if available)
    let meanCF = null;
    if (hasCF) {
      const cfComposite = ee.ImageCollection(ee.ImageCollection(chosenDS).filterDate(chosenStart, chosenEnd).select('cloud_fraction')).mean();
      meanCF = await cfComposite.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region200,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('cloud_fraction').getInfo();
    }
    console.log(`Mean cloud fraction: ${hasCF ? (meanCF !== null ? meanCF.toFixed(3) : 'n/a') : 'n/a'}`);

    // Background estimate on ring
    const bgMedian = await composite.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.median(),
      geometry: ringBG,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('signal').getInfo();

    if (bgMedian === null || Number.isNaN(bgMedian)) {
      console.log("Background median invalid.");
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }
    console.log(`Background median: ${bgMedian}`);

    // Excess signal (background-subtracted, positive only)
    const excess = composite.subtract(ee.Number(bgMedian)).max(ee.Image.constant(0)).rename(['excess']);

    const excessCount = await excess.gt(0).selfMask().reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region200,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('excess').getInfo();

    const sumExcess = await excess.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: region200,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('excess').getInfo();

    console.log(`Excess pixels (>bg): ${excessCount || 0}, Sum excess: ${sumExcess !== null ? sumExcess : 0}`);

    if (!sumExcess || sumExcess <= 0) {
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }

    // Weighted centroid by excess
    const lonLat = ee.Image.pixelLonLat();
    const wLon = lonLat.select('longitude').multiply(excess).rename('wlon');
    const wLat = lonLat.select('latitude').multiply(excess).rename('wlat');

    const sums = await ee.Image.cat(wLon, wLat, excess.rename('w')).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().repeat(3),
      geometry: region200,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();

    const wSum = sums.w;
    const lonSum = sums.wlon;
    const latSum = sums.wlat;

    if (wSum === null || lonSum === null || latSum === null || wSum === 0) {
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }

    const cenLon = lonSum / wSum;
    const cenLat = latSum / wSum;

    if ([cenLon, cenLat].some(v => v === null || Number.isNaN(v))) {
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }

    // Bearing and distance
    const vLon = 177.18 * Math.PI / 180.0;
    const vLat = -37.52 * Math.PI / 180.0;
    const cLon = cenLon * Math.PI / 180.0;
    const cLat = cenLat * Math.PI / 180.0;
    const dLon = cLon - vLon;

    const y = Math.sin(dLon) * Math.cos(cLat);
    const x = Math.cos(vLat) * Math.sin(cLat) - Math.sin(vLat) * Math.cos(cLat) * Math.cos(dLon);
    let brg = Math.atan2(y, x) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
    brg = (brg + 360.0) % 360.0;

    const cenGeom = ee.Geometry.Point([cenLon, cenLat]);
    const distM = await volcanoPt.distance(cenGeom, 1).getInfo();
    const distKm = (distM || 0) / 1000.0;

    console.log(`Centroid (lat, lon): ${cenLat.toFixed(4)}, ${cenLon.toFixed(4)}`);
    console.log(`Distance from vent: ${distKm.toFixed(1)} km`);
    console.log(`Bearing vent→centroid: ${brg.toFixed(1)}°`);

    if (Number.isNaN(brg)) {
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }

    // Decision: South if bearing in [135°, 225°]
    const isSouth = (brg >= 135.0 && brg <= 225.0);
    console.log(`Southward plume? ${isSouth ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`);
    console.log(isSouth ? "A" : "B");
  } catch (err) {
    console.log("D");
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
